IAED 201.name: Interior Design Studio I
IAED 201.description: Applying fundamental schematics in spatial design problems. Applying interior construction knowledge in interior design specific problem solving. Awareness of human factors in various design settings.

IAED 202.name: Interior Design Studio II
IAED 202.description: Applying fundamental schematics in spatial design problems. Applying interior construction and materials knowledge in interior design specific problem solving. Awareness of lighting factors applications in interior design problems.

IAED 211.name: Media and Artificial Intelligence for Representation
IAED 211.description: Computer-generated 2D drawings of the design concepts, dimensions, process and materials, alongside an introduction to 3D visualisation technologies, Artificial Intelligence-supported design tools, and digital representation methods for the creation and communication of design ideas.

IAED 221.name: Human Factors
IAED 221.description: Human factors/ergonomics as a determinant in the design of interior environments. User-centered approach to design. Universal design. Principles of applied anthropometry. Public spaces. Residential spaces.

IAED 231.name: Advanced Design Graphics
IAED 231.description: Study of presentation techniques employing various media. Use of appropriate light, shade, textural and color effects to communicate interior design concepts.

IAED 244.name: Lighting Design and Artificial Intelligence Integration
IAED 244.description: Physics of light. Vision and Perception. Lighting design principles. Artificial light sources. Natural light. Lighting applications + Artificial Intelligence. Colour and colour design.

IAED 251.name: Construction and Materials I
IAED 251.description: Basic elements and components of a building. Developing surveying skills. Production of construction drawings.

IAED 252.name: Construction and Materials II
IAED 252.description: Behavior and properties of building materials. Selection criteria, applications and sustainability concerns. Staircase details. Reflected ceiling plans. Production of construction drawings.

IAED 290.name: Summer Practice I
IAED 290.description: Summer training on site and/or in production techniques. Minimum required time is 4 weeks.

IAED 301.name: Interior Design Studio III
IAED 301.description: Public and semi-public interiors. Inclusive design detailing. Documentation for production. Building construction systems. Construction components.

IAED 302.name: Interior Design Studio IV
IAED 302.description: Social public interior spaces. Environmental design. Inclusive design detailing. Documentation for production. Building construction systems. Construction components.

IAED 311.name: Computer Aided Design
IAED 311.description: Gaining and demonstrating competency in CAD and multimedia presentation techniques through projects. Applying different representation techniques and the possibilities of mixed media.

IAED 315.name: Computerized Presentation Techniques
IAED 315.description: Advanced usage of computerized programs for representation of the student projects by integrating classical and computer media.

IAED 316.name: Computer Applications
IAED 316.description: Implementation of Building Information Modelling (BIM) technology in the field of Interior Architecture. Gaining knowledge on data management and scheduling, 3D visualization, virtual collaboration, and improved accuracy. Learning new design methods for interior architecture.

IAED 322.name: People and Environment
IAED 322.description: Environment and social behavior. Environmental perception and cognition. Environmental appraisals. Environmental psychology research methods. Implications for design.

IAED 341.name: Architectural Acoustics and Building Safety
IAED 341.description: Acoustics, noise control and fire prevention in environments/buildings.

IAED 342.name: Sustainable Design for Interiors
IAED 342.description: Concepts of sustainable design. Water use, energy conservation, thermal comfort and indoor air quality. Sustainable services of cold and hot water supplies. Interior design applications of heating, ventilation, sanitation and sewage disposal. Principles of alternative energy.

IAED 351.name: Detailing Studio
IAED 351.description: Interior architectural detailing. Use of materials. Producing application drawings and within project referencing.

IAED 365.name: Places/Memories
IAED 365.description: Definition of individual and collective memories; space and social frameworks as determinant factors for the formation of memory. Relations with everyday life, private and public spaces, lived spatiality, and bodily practices are examined. In relation with these definitions, formation of history memory relationship with examples from socio-spatial practices, literary sources and published memoirs are discussed.

IAED 381.name: Product Detailing
IAED 381.description: Detailing problems of products. Detailing of furniture, cabinetry, upholstery, fixtures, etc. Problems related to the nature of materials and production methods.

IAED 390.name: Summer Practice II
IAED 390.description: Summer training in an interior architecture/architecture/design office. Organization, project developing order, project application, designer/client relationships. Minimum required time is 4 weeks.

IAED 391.name: Special Topics in Interior Design I
IAED 391.description: Topics of special interest. Research and investigation of specific design issues.

IAED 392.name: Special Topics in Interior Design II
IAED 392.description: Topics of special interest. Application of understanding to competency level of design knowledge.

IAED 393.name: Visionary and Future Environments
IAED 393.description: Challenges of living in space. Needs analysis. Requirements of the physical and social environments in space. Project development for space settlements in digital medium.

IAED 394.name: TV Set Design
IAED 394.description: TV Set Design. Application of theory into practice. Developing interior design considering TV studio cameras and TV studio light.

IAED 396.name: Architectural Photography
IAED 396.description: Photography for analyzing and documenting architecture. Basics of photography. Photography for visualizing design ideas.

IAED 397.name: Color Theory and Applications
IAED 397.description: Basic color terminology. Color systems. Color vision and perception. Color interactions and contrasts. Harmony of colors, color schemes and compositions. Color planning and applications in design and architecture. Color research.

IAED 401.name: Interior Design Studio V
IAED 401.description: Design of complex interior architectural spaces. Advanced solutions of spatial planning and layout. Consideration of functional program and user requirements. Standards, codes and regulations. Detailing, materials and furniture. Current issues. Advanced architectural drawing and presentation.

IAED 402.name: Interior Design Studio VI
IAED 402.description: Design of complex interior architectural spaces. Complete solutions of spatial planning and layout. Consideration of functional program and user requirements. Standards, codes and regulations. Detailing, materials and furniture. Current issues. Advanced architectural drawing and presentation.

IAED 415.name: Advanced Detailing Studio
IAED 415.description: Building systems and materials. Modular interior systems. Comprehensive and detailed project development.

IAED 418.name: Interior Design: Professional Practice and Ethics
IAED 418.description: Administration of a major interior design project. Client and trade relations. Codes, government and legal requirements. Ethical standards and professional responsibility.

IAED 424.name: Experience of Space and Place
IAED 424.description: Review of human experience of space and place; analyses of the developing and emerging concepts in human-environment interaction through psycho-spatial approaches; methods on psychological, physiological and emotional measures; experimental design on human experience using different platforms such as virtual reality, aging simulation and serious game.

IAED 426.name: Leisure Practices and Spaces
IAED 426.description: A comprehensive understanding of leisure issues. The transformation in the definition and practices of leisure. Developing a basis for the critical analysis of new leisure spaces. Analysis through extensive reading and observation on relevant sites.

IAED 461.name: Environmental Management and Sustainable Development
IAED 461.description: Sustainable systems and techniques. Innovative system thinking for sustainable development. Practice skills for environment management. Economic and organizational dimensions of environmental decisions.

IAED 463.name: History of Interior Design and Furniture
IAED 463.description: Understanding the historical evolution of interior design, furniture design and industry. Developing research skills. Raising awareness of and recognising the connections between history and today.

IAED 464.name: Issues and Themes in Industrial Design
IAED 464.description: Raising awareness on profession of industrial design. Developing research skills. Production of design solution on an industrial design project.

IAED 481.name: Product Detailing Studio
IAED 481.description: Design and detailing of modular interior systems, products and furniture. Understanding of materials, joinery, fixtures. Prototyping. Programming and coordinating production.

IAED 483.name: Housing Typologies
IAED 483.description: A theory of design course that deals with social, economic, environmental, architectural, climatic factors that lead to the formation of different types of housing and their internal organizations. Delineates the values of home-making, house, housing as well as the tools of design, construction and the housing market. Explores interpretation and evaluation of the built environment under different historic, geographic, societal, political conditions; with regard to design-desk, construction processes, historiographic, cultural and discursive aspects.

IAED 491.name: Current Issues in Interior Design I
IAED 491.description: Innovative planning. Current design issues. Development of advanced design skills.

IAED 492.name: Current Issues in Interior Design II
IAED 492.description: Specialized issues related to contemporary techniques and materials. Special interior design problem solving.

IAED 501.name: Graduate Studio I
IAED 501.description: Analysis, discussion and evaluation of design problems. Establishing design requirements. Organizational, spatial and environmental criteria for design.

IAED 502.name: Graduate Studio II
IAED 502.description: Research on a particular topic. Evaluation of research cases. Developing the criteria for research. Data gathering tools. Evaluating data, findings and discussion.

IAED 511.name: Research Methods I
IAED 511.description: System and methods for information acquisition. Verification of sources. Interpreting information. Hypothesis formulation. Understanding and studying the issues related to interiors.

IAED 512.name: Statistical Analysis
IAED 512.description: Principles of statistical analysis methods. Concepts of data collection and structuring. Tools to deal with large amounts of data and to draw conclusions from such data.

IAED 514.name: Research Methods II
IAED 514.description: Techniques for crafting a speech and writing an essay. Conducting an actual research project in interior and/or environmental design for delivery of speech and publication.

IAED 524.name: Construction of Design as a Social Practice
IAED 524.description: Exploring the interpretation and evaluation of natural and built environments in various research approaches. Discussing each as different ways of examining environment-behavior relationships. The emphasis on design research, environmental evaluation, and social practice of design.

IAED 543.name: Environmental Analysis I
IAED 543.description: Techniques and methods to analyze physical and social aspects of spatial formations.

IAED 544.name: Environmental Analysis II
IAED 544.description: Methodology of environmental research. Measuring techniques for environmental attitudes and user responses/behaviors. Analyses of findings.

IAED 571.name: Lighting and Color
IAED 571.description: Importance of light and color as design factors, physics of light, light and vision, light sources and lighting methods, symbolic and functional color, color in interiors.

IAED 574.name: Art, Science and Technology
IAED 574.description: Investigating the characteristics of various disciplines that relate to art, science and technology. Correlating to the unity of mankind.

IAED 576.name: Computers in Design and Architecture
IAED 576.description: Techniques and methods to understand and utilize different virtual environments in design. An overview of the relationship between immersive and non-immersive environments. Applications of virtual reality studies.

IAED 583.name: Design Principles and Theories
IAED 583.description: Design issues as nature of design. Design models. Analysis of an artifact. Creativity and design. Learning styles and design. Knowing and design. Comparison of design models in contemporary design literature.

IAED 585.name: Design Requirements
IAED 585.description: Requirement concept in product/space model environment. Problem analysis; user needs; system definition; refining the system definition, and; building the right system.

IAED 590.name: Seminar in Research Topics
IAED 590.description: Presentation on the progress of the graduate thesis work.

IAED 599.name: Master's Thesis
IAED 599.description: A research based thesis course on an individual project. Timely, relevant and substantial research on a topic in the general area of building science, design theories and methods, and environmental psychology. Topic to be agreed in consultation with a Master Thesis advisor.

IAED 690.name: Seminar in Advanced Research Topics
IAED 690.description: Presentation on the progress of the Ph.D. dissertation work.

IAED 699.name: Ph.D. Dissertation
IAED 699.description: A research based thesis course on an individual project. Timely, relevant, novel and substantial research on a topic in the general area of building science, design theories and methods, and environmental psychology. Topic to be agreed in consultation with a Ph.D. advisor. Principal authorship of at least one archival publication in a leading journal.
